aḷacchinna.p: [Aḷa+chinna=chida+ta] (ti) CL=8 Broken thumb and the big toe, who has broken thumb and the big toe
a: အဠစ္ဆိန္န(တိ)
လက်မ ခြေမ ပြတ်သော၊ သူ။

B:
aḷacchinna：aḷacchinna（ti）
အဠစ္ဆိန္န（တိ）
[aḷa+chinna=chida+ta]
[အဠ+ဆိန္န=ဆိဒ+တ]
Q: aḷacchinna：người bị cụt mất ngón chân hay ngón tay cái （không được thọ đại giới）
K:
aḷacchinna：＂အဠစ္ဆိန္န（တိ）
[အဠ+ဆိန္န=ဆိဒ+တ]
လက်မ ခြေမ ပြတ်သော၊ သူ။
DOP: aḷa ( and ala), m. [ cf S. lex. ala, n. ], 1. the claw of a crab ; M I 234, 13 (kakkaṭako ~aṃ abhininnāmeyya); Ja II 342, 20 (kuḷīro … °-dvayena pāde daḷhaṃ gaṇhi, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr °-vasena); 344, 12 (tassa dve ~ā sarīrato bhijjitvā ekamante patiṃsu); III 295, 12 (kakkaṭako … kākaṃ gīvāya ~ena daḷhaṃ gahetvā); Spk II 228, 13 (eko ~o paṭikkamitvā pati); — 2. a (scorpion’s) tail ; — see vicchikālikā sv vicchika ; — °- cchinna , mfn. , 1. with claws removed ; Ja I 505, 8´ (~o viya kakkaṭako); — 2. with thumbs and/or big toes mutilated ; Vin I 91, 10 (bhikkhū … ~aṃ pabbbājenti; Sp 1026, 27 : ~o ti yassa … eko vā bahū vā aṅguṭṭhakā chinnā honti); Kv 31, 31 ; Vin-vn 2486.
CPD: ala-cchinna & aḷa-cchinna , see aḷa ( v. l. ala) 1-2. ala-cchinna
